what: Everything the build emits, in three groups. INITIAL is the entry script plus the stylesheet, gzipped, which a visitor downloads before anything is interactive. DEFERRED is every other code chunk Rollup splits out, gzipped, today the lazily loaded constellation frame and the three.js it imports. STATIC is every other file in dist, measured RAW rather than gzipped because webp, jpg and woff2 are already compressed and gzipping them reports more bytes than the wire carries. Measured by scripts/battery.mjs with Node zlib gzipSync at its default level for the two code groups.
baselineRound: game-feel Round 6b (music; the first measurement that counts all three groups)
budgetNote: Threshold set from the Round 2 baseline with headroom for the Web Audio effects module (Round 4d), the outcome cinematics (Round 5) and the procedural music bed (Round 6). Round 3 spent 5072 bytes, Round 3.5 spent 384, Round 4a nothing, Round 4b spent 1122, Round 4c spent 39 net, and Round 4d spent 3477: twenty four synthesized voices, the engine that owns the context and the gesture unlock, the two persisted toggles and the severity mapping. No audio assets, so nothing here is a fetch or a license. The dev sound board is excluded from the build and the battery checks the built output for its marker. jsdom is a dev dependency and adds nothing here. Any library addition records its delta here in its own commit. Round 4e spent -14: the reduced-motion speed coupling and its mid-session effect came out, and nothing was added to the shipped bundle; the fixture is a test. Round 5 was given a sub-budget of 9,000 gzipped in brief v1.3 and spent 718 of it: four scenes rendered from one component with no new assets and no new dependency. The scene ANIMATIONS live in the stylesheet, which this budget does not measure (it measures the main JS chunk); src/index.css grew 1,817 bytes raw, and the built CSS chunk is 6,657 gzipped in total (this sentence said 6,676 until Round 6b; the measured field cssGzipBytesAtR6 is authoritative and prose beside a measured number is exactly where drift hides).
headroomNote: Headroom is not recorded here. It is derived by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs from the chunk the battery just measured, because a written headroom describes the baseline it was written against and goes stale the moment a round grows the bundle; Round 4c copied a stale one into its report twice.
correctionNote: Corrected three times now, each one a set somebody declared rather than derived, each found by the pass over the previous correction. First, at the opening of Round 6a: the budget counted the entry SCRIPT alone from Round 2 onward, so the stylesheet shipped unmetered and the headroom everyone reasoned from was 11,485 when the initial figure was 4,828. Round 5 is the clearest case, recording 834 gzipped against a 9,000 sub-budget while index.css grew 1,817 raw bytes nothing counted. Second, in 6a's own pass: that fix anchored both patterns to the entry chunk name, so the lazily split Constellation chunk stayed invisible at 129,274 gzipped. Third, in Round 6b's pass over 6a: the fix enumerated the DIRECTORY but declared the EXTENSIONS, filtering to js and css, so every image, font and SVG fell through, and it read one directory rather than walking the build tree, so the dist root's own files were invisible too. That is 813,681 raw bytes across 12 files against 266,012 gzipped of code, so a commit message reading 'the bundle budget counts what actually ships' was wrong by a factor of three and the Round 6a report built on it was wrong the same way. The layer now walks the tree, subtracts the code chunks it recognises, and counts everything left over. Static is defined by subtraction so a format nobody anticipated is counted by default.
thresholdNote: 140,000 on the INITIAL download is KEPT rather than raised, as it was in 6a: Round 6b spent 2,018 gzipped of a 2,500 sub-budget on the music bed: 1,565 the bed as first written, and 453 across two fix batches its own verification produced, which is where the interpolated fade model and the toggle-race fix live. It still fits at 2,810 of room, against 800 reserved for the Round 6c haptic tier. Raising a budget at the moment it begins to bind is how budgets stop working. The DEFERRED budget of 132,000 is unchanged. The STATIC budget of 820,000 is new in 6b and set just above the 813,681 that is already there, on the same terms as the deferred one: it bounds the group so nothing can grow in silence, and it is not an endorsement of the figure. Two live questions for the author, recorded here so the next round argues them rather than inheriting them. First, 129,274 gzipped of three.js for a decorative start-screen frame is more than the rest of the game's code, and a reduced-motion visitor never fetches it because that path renders the still SVG instead. Second, and larger, four webp backdrops come to 497,000 raw bytes, of which intro-vortex at 161,192 and defeat-sphere at 122,636 are each seen once per campaign at most; og-image.jpg, portfolio-card.webp and readme-banner.webp add 285,000 more that the running game never fetches at all and that ship because they sit in public/.
